name: mediadownloader
description: MediaDownloader — torrent search and download manager: a single-executable Rust client, a React dashboard, and a Cloudflare Worker for end-to-end encrypted remote access

scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:client
scripts.lint: oxlint . && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
